about_the_game:
Blast off into the cosmos in this high-speed racing game set in the vastness of space! Take control of a nimble spacecraft and navigate through an array of challenging levels, dodging robots, walls, and other dangerous obstacles. Your goal: speed! ...and to eliminate the robot space presence.

Some levels feature a top-down perspective with 2D steering, while others immerse you in a third-person view with full 3D movement. Your best laps generate a ghost spaceship to race against.

Test your reflexes, timing, and spatial awareness as you race through ever-evolving space environments, where speed is perhaps your only ally, and every turn could mean victory or disaster! GLHF
